title: Insight Global is looking for an Accountant to join a large materials distributo
text:
Insight Global is looking for an Accountant to join a large materials distributor company in Santa Ana, California. This candidate will be responsible for managing the entire customer rebates portfolio, handling the customer contracts, calculating monthly accruals and supporting payouts. This individual will be responsible for the entire portfolio, handling around 400 accounts. This role is 5 days onsite in Santa Ana, CA.
Qualifications:BA Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field3+ years of accounting experience within a mid-size or large companyStrong in Excel (SQL and macros are not needed but are a plus)Team-focused mindset, ready to collaborate with others
Plusses: FP&A experiencePublic Accounting experienceVendor Customer Rebate experience
